interpretation: Two /dev/mem reads returned the expected bytes from the test-owned page while the non-blocking watchpoint was enabled, yet no hit latched. The register readback and independent post-test check matched the original idle state. The reads may have been served without a new EMI transaction, for example by CPU caching; the test therefore does not establish that the hardware watchpoint is broken. It supplies no positive observation control and prevents treating either WLAN no-hit as evidence that CONSYS made no region-18 access. Do not replay the identical owned-page window.
